name: MixAI Music
subtitle: Your own music server
promotionalText: Stream your own music library from your MixAI server: gapless albums, crossfade, volume levelling, synced lyrics and offline downloads. No ads, no tracking.
description:
MixAI Music plays YOUR music: the albums on your own MixAI server at home. No ads, no subscription, no catalogue we sell you.

CONNECT
• Find your server on the Wi-Fi or type its address, then pair with a 6-digit code.
• Or sign in to your MixAI account and connect to your server from anywhere.
• Family profiles, each with its own history and queue.

LISTEN
• Albums play gapless; crossfade between other tracks (3 to 12 seconds).
• Volume levelling from the loudness your server measured, so no track jumps out.
• Start a mix: endless radio from your library, or from any song, album or artist.
• Synced lyrics, queue editing (play next, add to queue, reorder), shuffle, repeat and a sleep timer.
• Lock Screen, Control Center, AirPlay and Bluetooth controls, with an animated cover on the Lock Screen.

OFFLINE
• Download albums, playlists or single tracks for the road.
• Wi-Fi only by default, a storage limit you choose, and automatic downloads of what is up next.

EVERY SCREEN
• Hand the queue to your MixAI TV in one tap.
• Home Screen widget and Control Center control.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Start a mix in MixAI Music".

MixAI Music needs a MixAI server (free, self-hosted) with your own music files.
